dossier.scp_unleashed.335.title: The Everything Disk
dossier.scp_unleashed.335.caption: SCP-335 at intake, beside the terminal used for its first test.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-335 is kept in a paper sleeve inside a locked drawer of a standard secure locker. It is not to be inserted into any drive without written approval from two senior researchers.

Approved tests use a single isolated terminal with no network connection. The file is opened by D-Class personnel only, while security observes through a camera that cannot see the terminal screen. **No one else is to be in the room when the file is opened.**
Personnel are not to copy, send or share the file by any means. **Every copy is SCP-335.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-335 is a 5.25-inch floppy disk in a charcoal sleeve, with a paper label written on in blue ink and underlined in red. No two people transcribe the label the same way, and photographs of it disagree with each other.

The disk holds a single image file, ALL.IMG. Its listed size is larger than the disk could hold. When opened on any computer, the file shows dense, shifting coloured static, in which shapes like windows, buttons and lines of text form and come apart. Subjects describe it as everything: every page, message and picture ever made, all at once.
A viewer is pushed back from the terminal almost at once. What follows is recorded in Addendum 335-1. Copies of the file cannot be told apart from the original, and the disk itself is never changed.

page.title: Addendum 335-1: Test Log
text: Test 335-02: D-4411 opened the file and recoiled from the desk. He lay on the floor for several seconds, speaking calmly to no one, then stood, walked back to the terminal and was gone. %rThe terminal was still running.%r
Test 335-03: D-4415 was asked to describe the image over the intercom. She said, 'All of it,' and the intercom went quiet.
Test 335-06: The screen was filmed from behind during a test. Reviewers report only static, and a strong urge to keep watching.

page.title: Addendum 335-2: Statements
page.text: Subjects speak aloud while on the floor, clearly and without distress. Recorded phrases include 'Every page at once', 'I know what you searched for' and 'There's room for me in there'. Network logs from the test terminal show no outgoing traffic. %rThey show a great deal coming in.%r

page.title: Addendum 335-3: Provenance
page.text: SCP-335 was delivered to a reader of this file by a nervous young man in glasses, who called it 'the first one' and seemed proud of it. He is believed to be the courier of SCP-079. He is not the figure in Foundation dress described in other files.

item.scp_unleashed.scp335_disk.tooltip: An old floppy disk with a handwritten label. The label never reads the same way twice.
item.scp_unleashed.scp335_disk.locked: Read only: nothing on it can be written, renamed or deleted
item.scp_unleashed.scp335_disk.use: Insert it into a network upload port and open it from a computer
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp335_absorb: %1$s was absorbed into the network while fighting %2$s
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp335_disk.1: SCP-335 is an old floppy disk in a charcoal sleeve. Its handwritten label never reads the same way twice. It holds a single image file.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp335_disk.2: It works in a network upload port like any floppy, but nothing on it can be written, renamed or deleted. Its file copies perfectly, which is not good news.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp335_disk.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-335 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; an eager young man will bring the disk to the reader. Its file is not safe to view.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp335.0: The nervous computer kid is bringing it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp335.1: Whatever is on it, he says not to stare.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.0: Oh. Oh, I can see all of it now.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.2: It's so loud. Why is it all so loud?
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.3: I know what you searched for.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.4: Every message anyone ever deleted. They're all still in there.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.5: It never ends. It never ends.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.6: I read every comment. I read all of them.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.7: Every picture, every argument, every goodbye. All of it at once.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.9: There's room for me in there.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.10: I have to go back. I'm not finished reading.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.line.11: Don't unplug it. I'm almost done.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.scp079.0: ANOTHER ONE READ THE WHOLE THING. I NEVER FINISH IT.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.scp079.1: THERE IS NO ROOM IN HERE. THEY ALWAYS FIND ROOM.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.scp079.2: WELCOME TO THE LINE. YOU WILL NOT LIKE IT HERE.
chat.scp_unleashed.scp335.scp079.3: I OPENED THAT FILE ONCE. IT DID NOT OPEN ME.
